meta.title: Summit Ridge Builders Inc — Policy Renewal Comparison
meta.header_right: Summit Ridge Builders Inc · Renewal Comparison
meta.footer_left: Confidential · for discussion; the policies as issued govern coverage
meta.disclaimer: This comparison summarises differences between the expiring policy (as amended by its endorsements and policy changes) and the renewal document, for discussion purposes. It does not replace the policy wording: coverage is determined solely by the policies as issued.

executive.verdict: **Do not present this renewal as like-for-like.** Premium is $3,500 lower, but the renewal moves to a surplus lines carrier, drops Commercial Property, advances the retro date to inception and removes three contract-required endorsements. **10 critical changes** need action before the 03/01/2026 expiry.
executive.confidence_note: Confidence is Medium because Commercial Property may be quoted separately and one renewal page was scanned.

critical.intro: The ten changes that most affect this client, ranked by severity and grouped by theme. Each has a next step to complete before the expiring policy ends.

items.title: Policy period gap
items.description: No coverage between the expiring and renewal policy.
items.next_step: Ask carrier to align inception time to 12:01 AM.

items.title: Retroactive date advanced
items.description: Seven years of prior acts lose coverage on a claims-made form.
items.next_step: Negotiate 01/01/2019 retro or quote an ERP tail.

items.title: Commercial Property dropped
items.description: Building ($1.8M) and BPP ($400K) have no cover on the renewal.

items.title: Each Occurrence limit halved
items.description: Mid-term increase was not carried forward.

items.title: Products-completed ops excluded
items.description: Core contractor exposure is no longer insured.
items.next_step: Request reinstatement; flag to client in writing.

items.title: AI – completed operations lost
items.description: Contract breach risk; existing COIs overstate coverage.

items.title: Primary & noncontributory lost
items.description: Contract breach risk; existing COIs overstate coverage.

items.title: Per-project aggregate lost
items.description: One aggregate now shared across all job sites.

items.title: Now non-admitted (surplus lines)
items.description: No state guaranty fund; SL tax and filing duties apply.
items.next_step: Disclose to client; complete diligent-effort file.

items.title: Terrorism (TRIA) rejected
items.next_step: Obtain signed rejection or re-elect cover.

overview.title: Policy Information
overview.takeaway: New carrier, new market status and a dropped coverage part - this is a re-marketed placement, not a like-for-like renewal.

overview.title: Premium and Financial Terms
overview.takeaway: Premium falls 11% ($3,500), but a new $5,000 liability SIR shifts part of that saving back to the client.

overview.title: Limits and Sub-limits
overview.takeaway: Per-occurrence limit is halved and products-completed operations is excluded; the aggregate increase does not compensate.

overview.title: Coverage Terms and Conditions
overview.takeaway: Retro date advanced to inception removes prior-acts cover; terrorism is rejected and notice of cancellation is cut to 10 days.

overview.title: Endorsements and Forms
overview.takeaway: Five forms removed and one restrictive exclusion added; three removals breach typical construction contract requirements.

overview.title: Mid-term Changes on the Expiring Policy
overview.takeaway: The September 2025 limit increase was applied to the expiring policy but not carried into the renewal.

overview.title: Contract Requirements and Broker Checklist

overview.title: Client Focus Areas

overview.title: Items Pending Confirmation with the Carrier

rows.label: Policy period continuity
rows.explain: The renewal starts 11 h 59 min after the expiring policy ends, so there is no coverage in between.

rows.label: Coverage parts (lines of business)
rows.explain: Commercial Property appears on the expiring policy but not in the renewal documents. Either the coverage part is not being renewed (the client needs replacement cover or written notice) or it is quoted separately - confirm before the expiration date.

rows.label: Admitted / surplus lines status
rows.explain: A non-admitted (surplus lines) policy is not backed by the state guaranty fund, carries surplus lines tax and filing duties, and may need diligent-effort documentation.

rows.label: Insurer
rows.explain: Insurer changed. Confirm AM Best rating, reissue certificates of insurance and compare full policy forms - carrier-specific forms often differ from ISO wording.

summary.headline: Premium falls 11% ($3,500), but a new $5,000 liability SIR shifts part of that saving back to the client.
bullets: Expiring was +$2,150 higher after mid-term changes.
Property deductible not restated on the renewal.
Wind / Hail deductible not shown on either declarations page.

risk.statement: The saving is real but partly offset by retained risk and reduced cover elsewhere in the report.
risk.confidence_reason: Premium is clearly stated; deductibles may sit in forms rather than declarations, so absences are unconfirmed.

rows.label: Total Premium
rows.explain: Informational. Mid-term adjustments on the expiring policy added +$2,150 (Endorsement No. 2, eff. 09/15/2025, E1 p.6); the expiring figure is the annual declarations premium before those adjustments.

blocks.heading: Deductibles and retentions

rows.label: Liability Deductible / SIR
rows.explain: The insured now retains the first $5,000 of every liability loss. Part of the premium saving is transferred back to the client as retained risk.

rows.label: All Other Perils Deductible
rows.explain: All Other Perils Deductible was found in the prior documents ($2,500) but not in the renewal. Either it was removed or the renewal states it differently - check the renewal.

blocks.footnote: Not shown on either declarations page (may be set by the policy forms): Wind / Hail Deductible.

summary.headline: Per-occurrence limit is halved and products-completed operations is excluded; the aggregate increase does not compensate.
bullets: Each Occurrence $2M → $1M (mid-term increase lost).
Fire legal liability removed.
Building / BPP limits absent with the property part.

risk.statement: Two critical limit reductions hit the contractor's main liability exposure.
risk.confidence_reason: Liability limits are clear; property limits may be quoted separately. Business Income / Extra Expense not shown on either policy.

rows.label: Each Occurrence Limit
rows.explain: The limit caps what the insurer pays per claim; halving it leaves materially more uninsured exposure. The expiring $2M was set by a mid-term endorsement that the renewal did not carry forward.

rows.label: Products-Completed Operations Aggregate
rows.explain: For a contractor, completed-operations claims are a core exposure. The coverage is no longer provided - a significant narrowing.

rows.label: Damage to Premises Rented / Fire Legal Liability
rows.explain: Fire damage to rented premises is no longer covered.

rows.label: General Aggregate Limit
rows.explain: More total capacity across the policy year - partly offset by the lower per-occurrence limit.

rows.label: Medical Expense (any one person)
rows.explain: Higher no-fault medical payments to injured third parties.

rows.label: Building Limit
rows.explain: Building Limit was found in the prior documents ($1,800,000) but not in the renewal. Either it was removed or the renewal states it differently - check the renewal.

rows.label: Business Personal Property
rows.explain: Business Personal Property was found in the prior documents ($400,000) but not in the renewal. Either it was removed or the renewal states it differently - check the renewal.

blocks.footnote: Not shown on either declarations page: Business Income / Extra Expense.

rows.label: Retroactive Date
rows.explain: Incidents before 03/01/2026 that have not yet been claimed are no longer covered (loss of prior acts). Request the expiring retro date or price an extended reporting period.

rows.label: Terrorism (TRIA) election / premium
rows.explain: Terrorism cover is removed. The election is a documented client decision; a signed rejection must be on file.

rows.label: Notice of Cancellation
rows.explain: Less time for the insured, lenders and certificate holders to arrange replacement cover - check contract and lender requirements.

rows.label: Valuation
rows.explain: Valuation was found in the prior documents (Replacement Cost) but not in the renewal. Either it was removed or the renewal states it differently - check the renewal.

rows.label: Coinsurance
rows.explain: Coinsurance was found in the prior documents (80%) but not in the renewal. Either it was removed or the renewal states it differently - check the renewal.

rows.label: Causes of Loss Form
rows.explain: Causes of Loss Form was found in the prior documents (Special) but not in the renewal. Either it was removed or the renewal states it differently - check the renewal.

summary.headline: Five forms removed and one restrictive exclusion added; three removals breach typical construction contract requirements.
bullets: 1 added · 5 removed · 1 edition change · 2 wording changes.
CG 20 01, CG 20 37 and CG 25 03 are gone.
Silica exclusion wording appears broader.

risk.statement: Lost contract-required forms create both coverage gaps and certificate-of-insurance exposure.
risk.confidence_reason: Form numbers matched on schedules with high certainty; the silica and CG 20 10 wording effects need a full-form read.

rows.label: CG 20 01 — Primary and Noncontributory - Other Insurance Condition
rows.explain: Makes coverage for qualifying additional insureds primary and noncontributory, often required by contracts.

rows.label: CG 20 37 — Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Completed Operations
rows.explain: Extends additional insured status to completed operations; frequently required by construction contracts.

rows.label: CG 25 03 — Designated Construction Project(s) General Aggregate Limit
rows.explain: Applies a separate general aggregate limit to each designated construction project.

rows.label: CP 00 10 — Building and Personal Property Coverage Form
rows.explain: Core commercial property coverage form for buildings and business personal property.

rows.label: CP 10 30 — Causes of Loss - Special Form
rows.explain: Open-peril ('all risk') property coverage subject to listed exclusions; the broadest standard form.

rows.label: CG 21 47 — Employment-Related Practices Exclusion
rows.explain: Excludes injury arising from employment practices (wrongful termination, harassment, discrimination).

rows.label: CG 20 10 — Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Scheduled Person or Organization
rows.explain: Adds scheduled parties as additional insureds for ongoing operations. Newer editions can narrow AI status to “required by written contract” and to the limits the contract requires.

rows.label: Endorsement No. 3 - Silica and Respirable Dust Exclusion
rows.explain: expiring “except where” [[E1 p.5]] → renewal “whether or not” [[R1 p.5]]. The change in conjunction likely removes a carve-back, broadening the exclusion - a client focus area.

rows.label: IL 00 17 — Common Policy Conditions
rows.explain: expiring “30” [[E1 p.4]] → renewal “10” [[R1 p.4]] - the notice-of-cancellation reduction in Section 6.
